pipeline_suggestions.title: Configure detekt with custom rules for empty catch blocks
pipeline_suggestions.description: Set up detekt configuration to enforce proper exception handling patterns and prevent empty catch blocks. Add custom naming conventions for ignored exceptions.
pipeline_suggestions.expected_impact: Will eliminate critical empty catch block violations and improve error handling consistency.
pipeline_suggestions.reason: Critical empty catch block finding shows lack of proper static analysis configuration for exception handling.

pipeline_suggestions.title: Establish function complexity and nesting guidelines
pipeline_suggestions.description: Create coding standards that limit function nesting depth to 3 levels and cyclomatic complexity to 10. Include refactoring patterns for complex functions.
pipeline_suggestions.expected_impact: Will prevent deep nesting issues and improve code maintainability and readability.
pipeline_suggestions.reason: Major deep nesting finding in bulkImport function indicates need for complexity management guidelines.

pipeline_suggestions.title: Implement automated test generation for new code changes
pipeline_suggestions.description: Set up tooling to automatically generate test stubs for new functions and classes. Configure CI to require tests for new code additions.
pipeline_suggestions.expected_impact: Will improve test coverage and ensure new functionality is properly tested from the start.
pipeline_suggestions.reason: Test health score of 0.75 with new_tests=false shows lack of test creation for new code changes.

pipeline_suggestions.title: Integrate pre-commit hooks with detekt and test validation
pipeline_suggestions.description: Configure pre-commit hooks to run detekt analysis and require passing tests before commits. Block commits with critical or major code smell violations.
pipeline_suggestions.expected_impact: Will catch code quality issues earlier and prevent critical violations from reaching the repository.
pipeline_suggestions.reason: Code smells score of 0.68 with critical and major findings shows need for earlier quality gates.
